namespace PGame

namespace Domineering

  (Equiv.refl ℤ).prodCongr (Equiv.addRight (1 : ℤ))

/-- The equivalence `(x, y) ↦ (x+1, y)`. -/

def shiftRight : ℤ × ℤ ≃ ℤ × ℤ :=
  (Equiv.addRight (1 : ℤ)).prodCongr (Equiv.refl ℤ)

  b ∩ b.map shiftUp

  b ∩ b.map shiftRight
